name: Switzerland

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 9051029 inhabitants, recorded as 9.051 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.
Opening estimate, produced with no source and no research. It exists to be falsified, not to be used as data.

Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. One establishment retained, the value moving from 0 to 1: the Accademia Teatro Dimitri in Verscio, Ticino, affiliated since 2006 to SUPSI, the public university of applied sciences of Italian-speaking Switzerland. Criterion read at source: a Master of Arts in Theatre of four semesters and 120 ECTS, one of whose three streams is Figure Theatre, explicitly defined as material, object and puppet theatre. Puppetry is therefore a named stream of a master's award at a public higher education institution. The previous 0 was an estimate made without research and was wrong. Upper bound at 2: German-speaking provision was not checked one by one, and the continuing education course in figure theatre identified elsewhere stays outside the denominator, not being degree-granting in the sense used here.

establishments.name: Accademia Teatro Dimitri (SUPSI)
establishments.award: Master of Arts in Theatre, Figure Theatre stream, 120 ECTS
establishments.description: Founded by the clown Dimitri in 1971 and absorbed into SUPSI, the public university of applied sciences of Italian-speaking Switzerland, in 2006. One of its three master's streams is figure theatre, defined as material, object and puppet theatre.
